verdict: Meta is delivering leads efficiently; Google spend needs immediate reallocation.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 118 leads entirely from Meta at a cost of $25.60 per lead — and over the most recent 7 days, lead volume rose 33% while cost per lead dropped 44%, confirming Meta is accelerating in the right direction. At the same time, Google Ads consumed $1,950 of your budget over the same 28-day window and produced zero conversions, with the top campaign alone accounting for $1,463 of that spend. We are redirecting Google budget toward what is working and will have offline conversion tracking live by end of August to ensure every lead is measurable across both channels. You should expect continued lead volume growth from Meta next period as that reallocation takes effect.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, every one from Meta
cost per lead this period, down 44% in the last 7 days
spent on Google Ads this period with zero leads attributed

watch_item.issue: 118 leads entered your pipeline this period but none have advanced to appointments or closed opportunities, pointing to a gap in intake or follow-up.
watch_item.fix: We are auditing the lead-to-appointment path now and completing the CRM build to ensure no lead goes unworked.
